{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Tsaiwinokka_hoyakut-BOS.png|thumb|250px|[[Korriban zombie|Korriban zombies]] could be created through [[Sith necromancy|necromancy]].]]
{{Quote|This complex spell animates both the freshly dead and the skeletons of the carrion fields, transforming them into an unstoppable legion impervious to pain and able to transmit a necromancy infection by biting.|[[Sorzus Syn]], extract from [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|Chronicle of Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut''', translated as '''Reanimated Dead''' from the [[Sith (language)|Sith language]], was a [[Sith sorcery/Legends|spell]] that could be used to create [[Korriban zombie|undead]]. This complex spell could awaken the [[Death/Legends|freshly-dead]] and [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]], transforming them into an unstoppable legion impervious to pain and capable of transmitting a necromantic infection through biting. [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] was the one who successfully melded spellcasting and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]], to perfect [[Sith necromancy|necromancy]]. [[Sorzus Syn]] expressed regret at not being able to meet him, and recorded the spell in her journals.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] learned this ability, bringing up the corpses of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to assist her against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Battle of Ohma-D'un]].<ref name="Republic 52">''[[Republic 52]]''</ref>


==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut, or Reanimated Dead: This spell is basically zombie-making, and could arguably have originated the moment a bunch of skeletons came to life in 1995's Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith.|Daniel Wallace, in his endnotes for ''Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side''|<ref name="BOS endnotes" />}}
Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BOS" /> In his endnotes for the ''Book of Sith'', Wallace revealed that the spell had been created with [[Korriban zombie]]s in mind.<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 1)}}</ref> In the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] continuity, according to a [https://www.fandom.com/articles/sith-dagger-star-wars-rise-of-skywalker-translation?fbclid Fandom article], the spell was mentioned on the [[Blade of Ochi of Bestoon]] as the inscription "Isaiwinokka Hoyakuts" with "T" misspelled as "I".<ref name="Fandom article">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fandom.com/articles/sith-dagger-star-wars-rise-of-skywalker-translation|text=Here's a Translation of What the Sith Dagger in 'The Rise of Skywalker' Says|work=Fandom.com|archivedate=20230906093655}}</ref>
